user.title: Choose country
user.description: Choose a country, then narrow the location by region and county where available. Enter any city or town manually; online city lists are incomplete.

region.title: Choose region
region.description: Choose a broad region. The next step narrows to a county or sub-region.

city.title: Choose city
city.description: Enter any city or town name. This avoids incomplete city lists and supports small towns and rural locations.

area.title: Choose local area
area.description: Choose a local area, then optionally select services to check for daily crowns. For Chastify, open [Developer API documentation](https://docs.chastify.net/developer-api/external-api-programs/) to create a user-wide DEV key with locks:read permission. EmlaLock and Chaster credentials are optional.

data.participation_providers: Services to check for daily crowns (select none, one, two, or all three)

county.title: Choose county or sub-region
county.description: Choose a county or local sub-region within the selected region, or skip this level where county data is unavailable.

participation_credentials.title: Credentials for selected services
participation_credentials.description: Only services you selected are shown here. Leave a service's credentials blank if you do not want to configure it.

data.chaster_access_token: Chaster developer or OAuth access token
